text_block_list.text:
For today's training—
Mihono Bourbon is wearing her racewear.
It's meant to test its comfort while running, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Initiating uphill training.
Master, please provide detailed instructions—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Master?

The more I look at it, the more sci-fi this outfit feels.
It suits her well, but... I wonder what
the intention was behind this design.
choice_data_list: Did you design the outfit yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply sorry.
I should have sought Master's instructions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, seeing as you appeared quite busy,
I consulted with my father, and as a result—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Think for yourself.
Your Trainer would surely say the same."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Having received the response, initiated thought process.
Design to achieve S-rank self-evaluation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Range of motion and mobility both show no issues.
I have concluded and confirmed that running
at a constant 100% operational capacity is viable.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"However...
was there some sort of issue?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My interest, you ask?

"Racewear is an important outfit.
Even more so if you designed it yourself, you're bound to feel strongly about it."
"That is precisely why I told them I was curious as to why they chose this design."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Could I have some of your time after training, then?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I shall resolve Master's questions.

And after training,
Mihono Bourbon brought me to—

It was a planetarium.
In that case, the design for the racing outfit must be...
choice_data_list: Like, inspired by a spaceship or something?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: To be precise, that is incorrect.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: More precisely, they are fighter planes... flying through space, perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This was when I was a child.
My father turned on the TV to check the weather forecast, and—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Instead of the weather forecast, the screen was displaying
an anime set in space.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Amongst the rocks drifting in space,
the red contrail of a fighter craft came into view.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Her overwhelming speed and technique.
I was completely captivated by her unfathomable energy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Without changing the channel,
my father simply said to me as I stared at the screen:

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Incredible... To think she can fly so fast."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Power acknowledged even by Father.
A quality worthy of being drawn to.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I thought about it, and spoke without realizing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I want to run like that.
Endlessly, on and on.
If only I could run with boundless power.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My father laughed and told me,
"I bet that feels great too."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: At that moment, a slight heat arose within my body, detecting status: 'Yearning'.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, this Racewear reflects
the passion of that very moment.
choice_data_list: So that's why you went with that design...
I know how it feels to look up to someone!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I would grade myself an S,
but how would Master evaluate it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Was it... strange?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps I truly should have
left the final decision to Master—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I, see.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Mihono Bourbon exclusive racing outfit.
Master's approval deemed granted.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Master.
Surrounded by a gentle aura, Mihono Bourbon mumbled somewhat bashfully.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Really...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Though our crafts and those
flying through space are entirely different...

Isn't it precisely because it's different that we admire it?
Transforming into a humanoid form, possessing both speed and strength—
just imagining such a figure—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Confirmation: 'Feelings' successfully shared.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Master.
That is very "hot."
Afterward, while enjoying the planetarium, Mihono Bourbon gave a small smile.
